title: A Story for Every Night
subtitle: 365 Goodnight Tales from Wildhaven
author: S. J. Tang
format_note: Anthology — the one Kindle category where 800+ pages is the honest selling point ('a story for every night of the year'). 365 stories x 380-450 words ≈ 150k words ≈ 800+ pages with per-story art and layout. Reflowable EPUB (text-led with spot images), NOT fixed-layout.
price_suggestion: US$7.99 — final price is the owner's decision
positioning: The bedtime anthology parents keep on the nightstand all year: tonight's story is always exactly one story long. Gentle, sleep-positive, zero cliffhangers, zero moralizing lectures. Set in the Wildhaven world (the critters from our games and picture books) so the cast compounds.
honesty_policy: BINDING: stories never mention products, apps, URLs or the store. Every story ends settled and sleepy — no cliffhangers, no fear beats near the end, no unresolved danger. No moralizing that shames a child (messiness, fear, mistakes are met with warmth). No invented 'ancient legends say' framing presented as real-world fact. Cover and description promise exactly what's inside: 365 original stories, length honesty (short stories, ~2 minutes each).

story_rules.structure: tiny problem or wonder -> gentle turn -> settled, sleepy ending in Wildhaven
story_rules.cast: rotate the ten critters (Flufftail, Pebblit, Aquaphin, Emberling, Mossback, Bubbletide, Zephyrix, Cinderpup, Glimmerwing, Nocturnix) plus recurring minor friends; every critter leads roughly 36 stories across the year
story_rules.endings: the last two sentences always wind DOWN: quiet, warm, eyes closing
story_rules.language: read-aloud friendly: rhythm over vocabulary, ages 3-8
story_rules.no_repeats: each story's central object/event must be new that month (tracked in month manifests)
story_rules.pronoun_canon: Fixed forever: Flufftail she, Pebblit he, Aquaphin she, Emberling she, Mossback he, Bubbletide she, Zephyrix she, Cinderpup he, Glimmerwing she, Nocturnix she. Every drafting prompt must include this line.

months.theme: Rain music — puddles, streams, storms passing
Water summer — ponds, boats, the shore
Cozy dark — lamps early, shadows friendly
The quiet festival — year's end, stars, rest

art: Spot illustrations from critters2.py sprinkled through (each month opener gets a scene; each story gets the lead critter's portrait at its head — generated, so zero marginal cost). Cover: night-sky Wildhaven with the cast asleep.
production: Parallel batches: ~10 stories/day drafted by agents against the voice anchor + month manifest, coordinator reviews every story for the ending rule and no-repeats, then commits. ~5-6 weeks to 365. Stories live in bookfactory4/stories/MM-DD-slug.md. scripts/bookfactory4.py status counts progress; build assembles the EPUB.
voice_anchor: stories/01-01-the-first-lantern.md (coordinator-written) — read before drafting any batch.
status: architecture complete; production begins with month 1
